## alice-dms-classify-document

Shared sub-workflow (PROJ-78): two-attempt document classification with confidence.
Called by both alice-dms-processor (nightly) and alice-dms-classification-backfill,
so the two never drift apart.

**Input**: { plaintext }
**Output**: { document_type, confidence, uncertain, classification_retried, classification_retry_failed, second_attempt_used }

1st attempt: temperature 0. If confidence < DMS_CLASSIFICATION_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD (default 0.7),
2nd attempt: temperature 0.3, same keyword-extended prompt. Higher confidence wins; ties go to 2nd attempt.
Existing parse-error retry (same prompt, temp 0) stays as a separate safety net.
